subject.title: docs: add product one-liner to AGENTS.md Start

question: Should root AGENTS.md include this one-line product and architecture context, or remain limited to operational policy and routing?
rationale: Source inspection can establish that the wording is accurate, but it cannot determine the intended long-term editorial scope of a root policy file.

options.title: Accept the context line
options.body: Merge the narrow insertion because its central product and Gateway wording matches canonical README language and helps agents orient before applying policy.

options.title: Keep overview in README
options.body: Decline the insertion if product explanation should remain outside root AGENTS.md to minimize policy-document scope.

recommendation.title: Accept the context line
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow insertion because its central product and Gateway wording matches canonical README language and helps agents orient before applying policy.
